notes.title: GAME UPDATE
notes.content:
[b]Hey, everybody! [/b]

It’s been almost two weeks since the game’s release, and during this time, we’ve managed to roll out several updates to improve the game experience. We've been actively gathering your feedback and making various adjustments to Beyond the Darkness. Of course, we’ve also been fighting bugs — what game development is complete without that? ;)

Here are some details on what’s been done so far:

[list]
[*] Improved clarity of the most challenging puzzle requirements in Acts II, III, and VI.
[*] Significant changes to the Act III location (addressed incorrect collisions, player navigation issues, and adjusted the "fairness" of enemies).
[*] Enhanced one segment of Act V to make it more convenient to progress through.
[*] Fixed transparency issues with certain obstacles in Act VI.
[*] Adjusted the volume of the English voiceover in Act VIII.
[*] Added camera inversion settings (per players’ requests).
[*] Expanded the sensitivity range for various input devices.
[*] Fixed the behavior of certain achievements (some players previously couldn’t unlock them right away).
[*] Changed DirectX version from 12 to 11.
[*] Added a new "Global Illumination Method" option in the graphics settings, allowing players to switch between a classic lighting model and the lumen technology-based lighting model (these last two changes should improve frame rates for players who encountered performance issues with lighting).
[*] Other small fixes and improvements to enhance gameplay quality.
[/list]

As you can see, we’ve been busy! ^^

Please continue to leave your feedback and comments — they really help us make Beyond the Darkness even better!

And, of course, a huge thank you for your support!

notes.title: GAME RELEASE
notes.content:
[b]The doors to the mysterious world of Beyond the Darkness are open![/b]

It's time to embark on a thrilling and dangerous adventure, where you’ll help a little girl Milly find her missing family. Upon waking, she realizes her parents and brother are gone, and strange darkness fills the hallways. The closer it creeps, the faster heart beats. Thankfully, Milly’s mom gave her a magical lamp! Turn it on, and the darkness retreats — but how long will its light last?

You’ll need to find a way out of the family home and venture into memory-worlds distorted by nightmares. Avoid monsters, solve puzzles, and don’t let the darkness consume you. The game features unique mechanics involving light sources and color changes.

[b]Experience the core gameplay features in the final trailer:[/b]

[previewyoutube=u8oaKYi1Rs4;full]https://youtu.be/u8oaKYi1Rs4[/previewyoutube]

Discover where the faint glow of an old lamp will lead you and find the courage to face your childhood fears in our new adventure game.

[b]Follow the butterfly![/b]

notes.title: RELEASE DATE
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Today we have exciting news: our game now has an official release date on Steam! 

In just a week, on November 14, you’ll be able to follow Milly’s story from start to finish. To celebrate this announcement, we’ve prepared a brand-new extended trailer showcasing a glimpse of gameplay, puzzles, some enemies, and, most importantly, the atmosphere of our game!

[i][b]Don’t forget to leave a like; we put a lot of effort into this ;)[/b][/i]

[previewyoutube=u8oaKYi1Rs4;full]https://youtu.be/u8oaKYi1Rs4[/previewyoutube]

In this final week before the release, we’re counting on your support. If you’ve already tried the demo, please share your impressions in the comments or in discussions. If you haven’t tried it yet – please give it a go!

We’ve put in a lot of work to catch all the bugs and errors. Just like Milly surrounded by monsters, we pushed through lines of code to make sure the game is fully polished for release and will bring you only joy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41218579/5c1890a6bc884d56c7b783c3e4a316896cd650ae.gif[/img]

Less than 7 days remain. Spread the word to friends, your favorite streamers, and share on social media. Meanwhile, we’ll continue to improve what can be improved. As they say, perfection has no limits! ^^

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41218579/4fbc04556057f91513ccef7e3460ad7cf846dd21.gif[/img]

And next Thursday, Beyond the Darkness will open its doors, welcoming all players into its dark world!

notes.title: The demo is now available!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

We’re thrilled to announce the release of our game’s demo! 

It features the opening locations and an introduction to the story, along with puzzles within the house, so you can jump right in, experience what the game’s about, and discover what makes it unique ;)

[previewyoutube=qasDHqI2c0o;full]https://youtu.be/qasDHqI2c0o[/previewyoutube]

We’ve also put a lot of work into improving and optimizing the project, so the system requirements are now much lower. But that’s not the end—we’ll continue to optimize Beyond The Darkness moving forward.

Right now, we really need your feedback to understand where to focus our efforts first. Please don’t hesitate to share what you liked, didn’t like, or absolutely loved. Every bit of feedback will be taken into account!

Based on the work ahead, we’ll set and announce the release timeline. Rest assured, we won’t keep you waiting too long ;)

So dive in and start conquering the darkness!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1728610/Beyond_The_Darkness/

notes.title: Meet Beyond The Darkness!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!!!

Today we'd like to talk a bit more about what the game is about, and what stage of development it's in. First of all, Beyond The Darkness is a dark adventure in the spirit of a nightmarish fairy tale. We aim to tell a story full of mystery and danger. The story is told on behalf of a girl named Millie. She will find herself in her own world, consisting of her home and other ‘spaces’ hidden behind closed doors. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41218579/ce8420bd73e014120e935a7b1906708750683ce1.jpg[/img]

Millie doesn't know how she got here, where her parents and brother have gone. The only thing she has at her disposal is an old lamp her mum gave her. Thanks to it, she can light her way and charge other lamps. However, the lamp's light is not infinite and you should use it wisely. All the more so because behind some doors monsters are waiting for the girl, eager to take away the light of her lamp. And if the light disappears..

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41218579/2e0f8fab738e5259d69b2165fa2d23403bf3999f.jpg[/img] 

It is up to you to help Millie find the right path, while solving logic puzzles along the way. As the story progresses, we will find more and more clues that reveal the backstory and open new doors. It's up to you to save the girl from the nightmare world.

________________
[b]What about development? [/b]

We've been working on the game for quite a while now and we can safely announce that we've reached the stage of polishing the gameplay. You can already go through Beyond The Darkness from the beginning to the end, all that's left is to make the light moments even brighter, the dark ones darker, and the puzzles even more exciting. To make the gameplay more immersive, not so long ago we switched ‘from the top’ camera to a closer version, but left the possibility to change everything to the original version in the settings. 

Also the model of the main character was slightly changed. There's a very interesting story about her in general, but it's better to tell it in a other post. In any case, we feel that we are reaching the finish line and we can already start telling you a lot of interesting things without fear that it will all change at the release.

________________
If you have any questions - feel free to ask, we'll be happy to answer them! We would be very grateful if you not only add our game to your wishlist, but also subscribe to us on social media:

notes.title: BEYOND THE DARKNESS: broadcast
notes.content: In Beyond The Darkness, help Millie conquer her fears and find her parents in a world of vivid memories. Maintain your lamp's light, use it to fight evil images, unlock doors, and navigate the eerie realm. Each level uncovers new aspects of her haunting past.
